fields.subject: How to set up SAML SSO with Okta
fields.threads:
[{"thread_type":"customer","body":"How do I configure SAML SSO with Okta? I couldn't find any documentation.","author_email":"user1@customer.com"},{"thread_type":"reply","body":"Great question! Here's a step-by-step guide since we don't have this documented yet:

1. Go to Okta Admin > Applications > Add Application
2. Select 'SAML 2.0' as the sign-on method
3. Set the Single Sign-On URL to https://app.example.com/sso/callback
4. Set the Audience URI to https://app.example.com
5. Under Attribute Statements, add: email -> user.email, name -> user.displayName
6. Download the metadata XML
7. In our app, go to Settings > Security > SSO and upload the metadata

We should really add this to our docs.","author_email":"agent@support.com"}]

fields.subject: Webhook deliveries failing intermittently
fields.threads:
[{"thread_type":"customer","body":"Our webhooks are failing about 30% of the time. How do we debug this?","author_email":"ops@techfirm.com"},{"thread_type":"reply","body":"Here's a comprehensive troubleshooting guide for webhook failures:

1. Check the webhook delivery log at Settings > Webhooks > Delivery Log
2. Look for HTTP status codes - 4xx means your endpoint rejected it, 5xx means your server had an error
3. Common causes: Timeout (must respond within 30s), SSL issues, Payload size over 256KB
4. To test: Use our webhook tester at Settings > Webhooks > Test Delivery
5. Enable retry mode: Settings > Webhooks > Advanced > Enable Auto-Retry","author_email":"agent@support.com"}]

fields.subject: How to create custom fields for contacts
fields.threads:
[{"thread_type":"customer","body":"I need custom fields for contacts. Couldn't find instructions in docs.","author_email":"admin@growthco.com"},{"thread_type":"reply","body":"Here's how to set up custom fields:

1. Navigate to Settings > Data Model > Custom Fields
2. Click 'Add Custom Field'
3. Choose field type (Text, Number, Date, Dropdown)
4. Set name and optional description
5. Under 'Visibility', choose which roles can see/edit
6. For dropdowns, add options in 'Values'
7. Click Save

Needs Admin permissions. This should be in our docs.","author_email":"agent@support.com"}]
